title: The Country Making College Loans Interest-Free (While America Still Debates Free Tuition)
description:
From 29 July 2026, Singapore launches the Higher Education Student Loan (HESL) — folding three older schemes into one. It can cover up to 100% of a student's subsidised tuition, charges no interest while you study, gives up to 10 years to repay (minimum S$100/month), and even includes a living allowance for meals and the commute. Set against the United States, where private-college tuition averages around $45,000 a year and "free tuition" is still a debate — two wealthy countries answering the same question in completely different languages.

Educational comparison only — not financial or immigration advice.
